summary: Corrected hybrid full/SWA automatic sizing so full-capacity EAGLE draft pools are charged for the target virtual span rounded to a page plus one page even when unified memory is disabled; retained reduced-capacity accounting for ordinary draft-SWA pools and added MXFP8 scale-byte coverage.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before run with allocator-accurate assertions: the prepared base required 72456601600 bytes for a 70276402380-byte budget; the separate MXFP8 fixture initially also exposed a test-fixture dtype publication error, which was corrected before final validation.
Three corrected issue-specific tests passed, covering eight full-capacity draft pools, page padding, and MXFP8 data/scale geometry.
44 tests and 7 subtests passed, including ordinary draft-SWA capacity boundaries.
FP32 matrix multiplication on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950-class GPU compared with a CPU FP64-derived reference; maximum absolute error 7.62939453125e-06.

remaining_limitations: The exact 8x NVIDIA B300, CUDA 13, TP8, Inkling-NVFP4 startup sequence was not executed because that architecture and model weights were unavailable.
No serving-path, FP4 kernel, semantic-accuracy, or distributed workload claim is made from the CPU sizing tests or the single AMD GPU numerical check.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
